title: lib_opencad and GDAL DWG/DXF route separation
mode: Broadened primary-source repository and documentation review; plan-only refinement
scope: Resolve the current declared version and evidence boundary of NextGIS lib_opencad.
Separate GDAL's lib_opencad-backed DWG route from its own DXF reader/writer route.
Refine the existing optional peer matrix without adding runtime dependencies, tests, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project repositories and official driver documentation
method.limitations: Repository README/history and official GDAL documentation establish declared route and version boundaries only. No local or peer runtime behavior was tested. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.finding: The current repository README says only DWG R2000 is supported.
sources.evidenceClass: project-declared version scope; not behavioral qualification

sources.finding: The visible repository history ends with a March 2023 commit and the repository has no published release listed.
The public test tree includes an r2000 sample-data directory; this does not establish comprehensive entity or version coverage.
The predecessor identifies itself as abandoned and directs users to NextGIS; its old status table reports only R15 basic-geometry reading.
sources.evidenceClass: lineage and historical scope; not successor behavior

sources.finding: GDAL says its read-only CAD/DWG driver uses lib_opencad and projects POINT, LINE, CIRCLE/ARC, and 3DFACE into OGR geometries.
sources.evidenceClass: official downstream route and declared projection

sources.finding: GDAL's separate DXF driver reads recent ASCII DXF, reads Binary DXF beginning in GDAL 3.12, writes AutoCAD 2004 DXF, tessellates/projectively transforms several entities, and can expose raw ASM plus transform for AC1027+ solids without constructing B-rep geometry.
sources.evidenceClass: official DXF route contract and explicit projection boundary

assessment.planImpact: Narrows the existing optional lib_opencad peer route to a project-declared AC1015/basic-geometry profile and makes explicit that GDAL CAD/DWG and GDAL DXF are different parser/operation routes. It adds no new implementation task, execution gate, support claim, or external-item transition.

verification.planDiffCheck: passed with git diff --check for the plan and receipt

workingTree: Extensively modified before this review. Plan update and receipt are unstaged and uncommitted; unrelated changes were preserved.
